
```{r}
dat <- data.frame(
  correct = as.factor(dat$correct),
  problem_type = as.factor(dat$problem_type),
  RT_response = as.numeric(dat$RT_response),
  Condition = as.factor(dat$Condition),
  problem_type = as.factor(dat$problem_type),
  subject_nr = as.factor(dat$subject_nr),
  trial = as.factor(dat$trial))
dat_filtered <- filter(dat, correct == 1)
```

```{r accuracy for Condition per problem_type + subjecct}
# --- 1. PREPARE RT DATA ---

se_func <- function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(na.omit(x)))

# A. Calculate Per-Subject Stats (Mean & SE) from dat_filtered
rt_mean <- aggregate(RT_response ~ Condition + problem_type + subject_nr, data = dat_filtered, FUN = mean)
rt_se   <- aggregate(RT_response ~ Condition + problem_type + subject_nr, data = dat_filtered, FUN = se_func)

df_rt <- merge(rt_mean, rt_se, by = c("Condition", "problem_type", "subject_nr"), suffixes = c(".mean", ".se"))
df_rt$problem_type <- factor(df_rt$problem_type)
df_rt$Condition    <- as.character(df_rt$Condition)
df_rt$subject_nr   <- as.character(df_rt$subject_nr)

# B. Calculate Aggregate Stats
agg_grand <- aggregate(RT_response.mean ~ Condition + problem_type, data = df_rt, FUN = mean)
agg_se_grand <- aggregate(RT_response.mean ~ Condition + problem_type, data = df_rt, FUN = se_func)
agg_grand$SE <- agg_se_grand$RT_response.mean
agg_grand$Condition <- as.character(agg_grand$Condition)
agg_grand$problem_type <- factor(agg_grand$problem_type, levels = levels(df_rt$problem_type))

# --- 2. CALCULATE GLOBAL Y-LIMITS ---
min_y <- min(c(df_rt$RT_response.mean - df_rt$RT_response.se, agg_grand$RT_response.mean - agg_grand$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(c(df_rt$RT_response.mean + df_rt$RT_response.se, agg_grand$RT_response.mean + agg_grand$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
global_ylim <- c(min_y, max_y)

# --- 3. PLOTTING ---
subjects   <- sort(unique(df_rt$subject_nr))
conditions <- sort(unique(df_rt$Condition))
cols_subj  <- rainbow(length(subjects)); names(cols_subj) <- subjects
ltys_cond  <- seq_along(conditions); names(ltys_cond) <- conditions
cols_cond  <- seq_along(conditions); names(cols_cond) <- conditions

op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, xpd = FALSE)

# PANEL 1: Aggregate Mean
plot(NA, xlim = c(1, length(levels(agg_grand$problem_type))), ylim = global_ylim,
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Problem Type", ylab = "Response Time (+/- SE)",
     main = "Average RT\n(Across Subjects)")
axis(1, at = seq_along(levels(agg_grand$problem_type)), labels = levels(agg_grand$problem_type))

for (c in conditions) {
  sub <- agg_grand[agg_grand$Condition == c, ]
  sub <- sub[order(sub$problem_type), ]
  x <- as.numeric(sub$problem_type)
  
  lines(x, sub$RT_response.mean, type = "b", lwd = 2, pch = 17, lty = ltys_cond[c], col = cols_cond[c])
  arrows(x, sub$RT_response.mean - sub$SE, x, sub$RT_response.mean + sub$SE, angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = cols_cond[c])
}
legend("top", inset = c(-0.35, 0), legend = conditions, lty = ltys_cond, col = cols_cond, lwd = 2, pch = 17, bty = "n", title = "Conditions")

# PANEL 2: Per-Subject Mean
plot(NA, xlim = c(1, length(levels(df_rt$problem_type))), ylim = global_ylim,
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Problem Type", ylab = "Response Time (+/- SE)",
     main = "Average RT\n(Per Subject)")
axis(1, at = seq_along(levels(df_rt$problem_type)), labels = levels(df_rt$problem_type))

for (s in subjects) {
  for (c in conditions) {
    subdata <- df_rt[df_rt$subject_nr == s & df_rt$Condition == c, ]
    if (nrow(subdata) == 0) next
    subdata <- subdata[order(subdata$problem_type), ]
    x <- as.numeric(subdata$problem_type)
    
    lines(x, subdata$RT_response.mean, type = "b", lwd = 1, pch = 19, col = cols_subj[s], lty = ltys_cond[c])
    arrows(x, subdata$RT_response.mean - subdata$RT_response.se, x, subdata$RT_response.mean + subdata$RT_response.se, angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.02, col = cols_subj[s], lwd = 1)
  }
}
legend("top", inset = c(-0.35, 0), legend = conditions, lty = ltys_cond, lwd = 2, bty = "n", title = "Conditions")

par(op)
```

```{r accuracy for Condition per problem type pro subject}
# --- 1. PREPARE ACCURACY DATA ---

# Create local copy and convert 'correct' to numeric (0/1)
dat_calc <- dat
dat_calc$correct <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_calc$correct))

# Define Standard Error function
se_func <- function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(na.omit(x)))

# A. Calculate Per-Subject Stats (Mean & SE)
stats_mean <- aggregate(correct ~ Condition + problem_type + subject_nr, data = dat_calc, FUN = mean)
colnames(stats_mean)[colnames(stats_mean) == "correct"] <- "Mean"

stats_se <- aggregate(correct ~ Condition + problem_type + subject_nr, data = dat_calc, FUN = se_func)
colnames(stats_se)[colnames(stats_se) == "correct"] <- "SE"

# Merge for per-subject plot
df_plot <- merge(stats_mean, stats_se, by = c("Condition", "problem_type", "subject_nr"))
df_plot$problem_type <- factor(df_plot$problem_type)
df_plot$Condition    <- as.character(df_plot$Condition)
df_plot$subject_nr   <- as.character(df_plot$subject_nr)

# B. Calculate Aggregate Stats (Grand Mean & SE across subjects)
agg_grand <- aggregate(Mean ~ Condition + problem_type, data = df_plot, mean)
agg_se_grand <- aggregate(Mean ~ Condition + problem_type, data = df_plot, se_func)
agg_grand$SE <- agg_se_grand$Mean # Assign SE

# --- 2. CALCULATE GLOBAL Y-LIMITS ---
# combining variability from both individual subjects and the group mean
min_y <- min(c(df_plot$Mean - df_plot$SE, agg_grand$Mean - agg_grand$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(c(df_plot$Mean + df_plot$SE, agg_grand$Mean + agg_grand$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
global_ylim <- c(min_y, max_y)

# --- 3. PLOTTING ---
subjects   <- sort(unique(df_plot$subject_nr))
conditions <- sort(unique(df_plot$Condition))
cols_subj  <- rainbow(length(subjects)); names(cols_subj) <- subjects
ltys_cond  <- seq_along(conditions); names(ltys_cond) <- conditions
cols_cond  <- seq_along(conditions); names(cols_cond) <- conditions

op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, xpd = FALSE)

# PANEL 1: Aggregate Mean
plot(NA, xlim = c(1, length(levels(df_plot$problem_type))), ylim = global_ylim,
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Problem Type", ylab = "Accuracy (+/- SE)",
     main = "Average Accuracy\n(Across Subjects)")
axis(1, at = seq_along(levels(df_plot$problem_type)), labels = levels(df_plot$problem_type))

for (c in conditions) {
  sub <- agg_grand[agg_grand$Condition == c, ]
  sub <- sub[order(sub$problem_type), ]
  x <- as.numeric(sub$problem_type)
  
  lines(x, sub$Mean, type = "b", lwd = 2, pch = 17, lty = ltys_cond[c], col = cols_cond[c])
  arrows(x, sub$Mean - sub$SE, x, sub$Mean + sub$SE, angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = cols_cond[c])
}
legend("bottom", inset = c(-0.35, 0), legend = conditions, lty = ltys_cond, col = cols_cond, lwd = 2, pch = 17, bty = "n", title = "Conditions")

# PANEL 2: Per-Subject Mean
plot(NA, xlim = c(1, length(levels(df_plot$problem_type))), ylim = global_ylim,
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Problem Type", ylab = "Accuracy (+/- SE)",
     main = "Accuracy by Subject\n(Individual SE)")
axis(1, at = seq_along(levels(df_plot$problem_type)), labels = levels(df_plot$problem_type))

for (s in subjects) {
  for (c in conditions) {
    subdata <- df_plot[df_plot$subject_nr == s & df_plot$Condition == c, ]
    if (nrow(subdata) == 0) next
    subdata <- subdata[order(subdata$problem_type), ]
    x <- as.numeric(subdata$problem_type)
    
    lines(x, subdata$Mean, type = "b", lwd = 1, pch = 19, col = cols_subj[s], lty = ltys_cond[c])
    arrows(x, subdata$Mean - subdata$SE, x, subdata$Mean + subdata$SE, angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.02, col = cols_subj[s], lwd = 1)
  }
}
legend("bottom", inset = c(-0.35, 0), legend = conditions, lty = ltys_cond, lwd = 2, bty = "n", title = "Conditions")

par(op)
```
```{r}
df_wide <- reshape(RT_con_PT_Sub, idvar = c("subject_nr","problem_type"),
                   timevar = "Condition", direction = "wide")
# Columns look like: RT_response.Progressive, RT_response.Randomised

# 3) Split by subject and run paired t-test
spl <- split(df_wide, df_wide$subject_nr)
res_list <- lapply(spl, function(d) {
  x <- d[["RT_response.Progressive"]]
  y <- d[["RT_response.Randomised"]]
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) {
    return(c(n_pairs=sum(ok), t=NA, df=NA, p=NA,
             mean_diff=mean(x[ok]-y[ok]), conf_low=NA, conf_high=NA))
  }
  tt <- t.test(x[ok], y[ok], paired = TRUE)
  c(n_pairs = sum(ok),
    t = unname(tt$statistic),
    df = unname(tt$parameter),
    p = tt$p.value,
    mean_diff = unname(tt$estimate),  # Progressive − Randomised
    conf_low = tt$conf.int[1],
    conf_high = tt$conf.int[2])
})
res <- data.frame(subject_nr = names(res_list), do.call(rbind, res_list), row.names = NULL)
print(res)
```
```{r}
# wide form
dfw <- reshape(RT_con_PT_Sub,
               idvar = c("subject_nr","problem_type"),
               timevar = "Condition",
               direction = "wide")  # gives RT_response.Progressive / .Randomised

# paired t-test per subject
by(dfw, dfw$subject_nr, function(d) {
  ok <- complete.cases(d[, c("RT_response.Progressive","RT_response.Randomised")])
  t.test(d$RT_response.Progressive[ok],
         d$RT_response.Randomised[ok],
         paired = TRUE)
})
```
